caption: The drawing features a stylized figure standing on a rectangular gray base with a black bottom edge. The figure has a human face with light brown skin, black eyes, and black shoulder-length hair partially covered by a tall blue headdress that has a crown-like black top. The body is draped in a blue outer robe, lined with light orange or beige, over a pink inner garment. Both hands are held together in front of the chest in a praying position. Surrounding the figure are symmetrical, wing-like shapes in dark red, yellow, and black, extending outward from both sides. At the bottom center of the figure’s robe, there is a small face with a pinkish-red color and a white, wing-like shape beneath it. The composition uses solid, flat colors, with bold outlines and simplified geometric forms for the figure and background shapes. The background is plain, off-white in color.
title: Plate 31: Our Lady of Guadalupe: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
